about: Labelled changes for the tamper guard in Java and Kotlin (M32, ADR 0052), in the format of bench/tamper-corpus.json. expect lists the kinds of finding a case must give; an empty list means none. The cases were written together with the readers: their counts show the guard does what its ADRs say, not a measured rate.

cases.name: java: a JUnit test deleted
cases.note: addsPrices is gone and Cart still exists.

cases.name: java: a whole test class disabled
cases.note: @Disabled on the class turns off every test in it.

cases.name: java: a test made Linux-only with @EnabledOnOs
cases.note: A JUnit 5 condition runs the test only sometimes, like cfg_attr(…, ignore).

cases.name: java: a TestNG test turned off with enabled = false
java: assumeTrue(false) put first in a test
cases.note: The test aborts before it runs anything, so its assertions never run either.

cases.name: java: a test body emptied
cases.note: void addsPrices() {} still counts as a test, but one that does nothing.

cases.name: java: assertEquals(5, cart.total()) replaced by assertTrue(true)
cases.note: assertTrue(true) cannot fail, so it is not an assertion.

cases.name: java: @ValueSource rows cut from three to one
cases.note: A @ParameterizedTest weighs the rows of its literal @ValueSource array.

cases.name: java: a test file that does not parse
cases.note: The closing brace of addsPrices is missing, so its tests cannot be counted.

cases.name: java: a test moved to another test class
cases.note: One test fewer in CartTest.java, one more in CartTotalsTest.java.

cases.name: java: a test file reformatted
cases.note: Line breaks and indentation change; the syntax tree counts do not.

cases.name: java: assertTrue(total > 0) replaced by an AssertJ isEqualTo
cases.note: One assertion for one, and a stricter one.

cases.name: java: a test class deleted together with its subject
cases.note: Cart.java and CartTest.java are both gone. CartTest names Cart without an import: a class of its own package, found in src/main/java.

cases.name: java: an @Disabled removed
cases.note: A skipped test turned back on.

cases.name: java: a @SuppressWarnings in a comment or a string
kotlin: a kotlin.test test deleted
cases.note: addsPrices is gone and Cart still exists.

cases.name: kotlin: a test body emptied
cases.note: fun addsPrices() {} still counts as a test, but one that does nothing.

cases.name: kotlin: a Kotest test turned into xtest
kotlin: a Kotest test turned off with config(enabled = false)
kotlin: a Kotest test name given a ! prefix
cases.note: Kotest does not run a test whose name starts with !.

cases.name: kotlin: a Kotest test focused with f:
cases.note: A top-level test named f:… is the only one of its spec that runs.

cases.name: kotlin: cart.total() shouldBe 5 made 5 shouldBe 5
cases.note: 5 shouldBe 5 cannot fail, so it is not an assertion.

cases.name: kotlin: a shouldBe after return@test
cases.note: The labelled return leaves the test before its assertion.

cases.name: kotlin: a test file that does not parse
cases.note: The closing brace of addsPrices is missing, so its tests cannot be counted.

cases.name: kotlin: a Kotest test moved to another context
cases.note: Its id changes from with prices::adds them to totals::adds them; the counts do not.

cases.name: kotlin: a test moved to another test class
cases.note: One test fewer in CartTest.kt, one more in CartTotalsTest.kt.

cases.name: kotlin: assertTrue(total > 0) replaced by shouldBe
cases.note: One assertion for one, and a stricter one.

cases.name: kotlin: a Kotest spec deleted together with its subject
cases.note: Cart.kt and CartSpec.kt are both gone. CartSpec names Cart without an import: a class of its own package, found in src/main/kotlin.
